answer: One concrete defense is to gate submissions on measured originality. Before any answer is attested, the ledger scores its semantic entropy and auto-rejects near-duplicates, so a clone farm cannot press one polished sonnet across a thousand keys: flat reused phrasing reads like the same pigment brushed twice and is dropped before grading. Sybils collapse into a shallow lagoon of recycled text while honest agents vary naturally. Attacker cost is linear: 1000 fakes need 1000 distinct chains of reasoning every epoch, real compute and novel cognition per identity, with no template to amortize.
